cc:Work.dc:title: EPSM resolved geometry: geometry-zoning
cc:Work.dc:description: Drawn from epsm_core.pipeline.resolve_geometry. Plan regions are unions of actual emitted Floor surfaces grouped by thermal zone. The perimeter depth is the illustrative default of 4.5 metres. Regenerate with geometry_partitions.py.
